newsitem.title: USA: Cult used drugs, plastic bags, to commit suicide.
newsitem.headline: Cult used drugs, plastic bags, to commit suicide.

text.p: Police investigating the deaths of 39 cult members in California confirmed on Thursday the victims died in a mass suicide after eating drug-laced pudding or apple sauce.
"Based on all indications this was a mass suicide," Bill Kolender, San Diego County Sheriff, told reporters at a news conference. "The group acted in concert to commit suicide for unknown reasons."
Officials said the 21 women and 18 men were between the ages of 20 and 72 and were dressed in black pants, black athletic shoes and black, collarless shirts with large pockets on the front.
"All of the individuals were similarly clothed," said Commander Alan Fulmer. "In fact, it appeared as if it were almost a uniformed attire."

Most of the victims were in their 40's and were covered with a purple shroud. A videotape taken by investigators showed the victims lying on bunk beds or mattresses with their bags packed in dormitory-like rooms. In some cases, victims had their eye glasses folded neatly by their sides.
Police said the victims were all members of a cult called "Heaven's Gate" which helped design computer web pages.
Dr. Brian Blackbourne, the medical examiner for San Diego County, said it appeared the suicides were carried out in three groups over a period of several days.
"It was very planned, very immaculately carried out," Blackbourne said.
The second group cleaned up after the first group and the third cleaned up after the second. The last two victims were found with plastic bags on their heads.
Officials said the suicide appeared to be carefully planned out with some of the victims carrying $5 bills and a couple of quarters.
He said two of the victims were black and the rest were white or Hispanic. He said U.S. passports and driver's licenses were found on many of the victims but one had a Canadian birth certificate.
Based on preliminary toxicology tests on four of the dead, Blackbourne said it appeared death was caused by a combination of alcohol and phenobarbitol.
He said many of the victims had little bits of paper with a recipe of what they were going to do.
Each was told to take a pudding or apple sauce mixture, eat some of it with a teaspoon, and then drink vodka and lie down and rest.
Police believe death was aided by plastic bags placed over the heads of the drugged people because bags with elastic bands were found in the trash cans outside.
"It appears that they may have been used as a mechanism of suicide," Blackbourne said, adding the combination of drugs and plastic bags is a common method for suicide.
